meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
For **dry skin in Indian winters**, I’d prioritize a **rich, fragrance-free moisturizer with ceramides + humectants** such as hyaluronic acid/glycerin. Creams generally work better than lightweight lotions when dryness is significant. [www.ceraveindia.com](https://www.ceraveindia.com/skin-smart/skincare-tips-advice/best-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top picks

### [Cetaphil DAM Daily Advance Ultra Hydrating Lotion]()

**1. CeraVe Moisturising Cream — best overall for very dry skin**  
Three ceramides + hyaluronic acid, fragrance-free and non-comedogenic. It's my first choice if your skin gets **tight, flaky or rough** during winter. [www.ceraveindia.com](https://www.ceraveindia.com/skin-smart/skincare-tips-advice/best-ceramide-moisturizer-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. Cetaphil DAM — best value/everyday option**  
A particularly good choice if you want something moisturizing without an extremely heavy cream feel. Cetaphil specifically recommends its richer moisturizers for winter dryness. **3. Bioderma Atoderm Crème — best for very dry/sensitive skin**  
A richer option if ordinary lotions aren't enough.

**4. Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid — good Indian alternative**  
Worth considering if you want a ceramide-focused moisturizer at a lower price.

**If I had to pick just one:** **CeraVe Moisturising Cream** for genuinely dry winter skin. Apply it to **slightly damp skin after washing**, which helps retain moisture. [www.pingmedoc.com](https://www.pingmedoc.com/pharmacy/buying-guides/best-moisturizer-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
